packages.name: intl
packages.source_fix: Local MSYS/native LLVM bridge: drain the archive pipe after its ELF-class byte is read, preventing llvm-ar from writing to a closed pipe; retain class output and read/drain failure status. Bash is the selected configure shell.

source_edits.after:
func_elfclass ()
      {
        # Keep llvm-ar's output pipe open until all archive data is consumed.
        od -A n -t d1 -j 4 -N 1
        acl_elfclass_status=$?
        cat > /dev/null
        acl_elfclass_drain_status=$?
        test "$acl_elfclass_status" -eq 0 || return "$acl_elfclass_status"
        return "$acl_elfclass_drain_status"
      }

func_elfclass ()
      {
        # This builder selects Bash; isolate pipefail to preserve dd failures.
        (
          set -o pipefail
          dd bs=1 count=1 skip=4 2>/dev/null | hexdump -e '1/1 "%3d "'
        )
        acl_elfclass_status=$?
        cat > /dev/null
        acl_elfclass_drain_status=$?
        echo
        test "$acl_elfclass_status" -eq 0 || return "$acl_elfclass_status"
        return "$acl_elfclass_drain_status"
      }
